::: c1 Johannes Marthinus = 6.2.1763
::: c2 Jacobus = 13.1.1765 x Kaapstad 6.6.1790 Johanna Magdalena Paulsen
:::: d1 Wilhelmina Maria = 18.3.1792
:::: d2 Carolus Fredericus = 20.9.1795
:::: d3 Jesaias Engelbertus Jacobus m Swellendam 12.9.1799 x Kaapstad 17.6.1821 Hannah Hayworth

::: c4 Maria Magdalena = 21.5.1769
::: c5 Marthinus = 12.8.1770
::: c6 Card Frederik = 11.8.1771
::: c7 Salomon = 8.1.1775
